The current two same-Level attachments are therefore only an approximation and are not exact for level-free, variable-count, alternate, or non-Level procedures.

effects.clause: When this card is used as Synchro Material for the Synchro Summon of a "Flower Cardian" monster, you can treat it as 3 non-Tuner monsters.
effects.lua: No Lua effect is registered for this clause. The former EFFECT_SYNCHRO_MATERIAL_CUSTOM block was removed because that hook is Omega's custom-Tuner procedure and Duel.SetSynchroMaterial receives a Group of physical cards; selecting Moonflare alone neither contributes three non-Tuner count slots nor preserves the required Tuner/non-Tuner procedure.
effects.notes: Omega supports custom Synchro material selection and alternate Synchro Levels, but not material-count multiplicity for one non-Tuner. Official EFFECT_SYNCHRO_MATERIAL_CUSTOM patterns still validate min/max using Group:GetCount and pass physical cards to Duel.SetSynchroMaterial. The previous code could expose an unintended custom-Tuner route while failing to count Moonflare as three non-Tuners, so that incorrect registration was removed. Exact support requires an engine material-count API or revised card text.

effects.clause: Up to twice per turn, during the Damage Step, if you activate a monster effect that would Summon a "Galactica" monster, you can add this additional effect to that card's effect at resolution.
effects.lua: A field continuous EVENT_CHAINING effect now recognizes every current qualifying Galactica Damage Step monster effect through aux.CCGGalacticaSummonEffects, with a concrete operation-info group fallback. On consent it saves re:GetOperation(), calls Duel.ChangeChainOperation, runs the original operation, and appends the destruction inside that same resolving Chain Link. A player flag counts only accepted additions and caps them at two per turn.
effects.notes: The prior EVENT_CHAIN_SOLVED action was a separate post-resolution event and its concrete-group test missed current non-targeting Galactica summons. The operation is now augmented in-chain and all current qualifying effects are explicitly registered.

effects.clause: ● Also after that, destroy 1 card on the field.
effects.lua: The replacement operation first invokes the saved original monster-effect operation, then selects and destroys exactly 1 destructible card on the field with REASON_EFFECT before that Chain Link finishes.
effects.notes: The destruction is no longer delayed until EVENT_CHAIN_SOLVED; it is appended after the original operation in the modified Chain Link.

Resolution needed: either errata the target to '1 face-up card your opponent controls' (the current safe behavior), or provide an authoritative ruling for face-down targets, after which distg/disop can be changed to that exact behavior. No unsupported face-down lingering negation was invented.

provenance.legacy_policy: Still-applicable manual unresolved classifications are preserved; all other conclusions are superseded by the fresh audit.

effects.clause: 1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monster
effects.lua: EnableReviveLimit and aux.AddSynchroProcedure(c,nil,aux.NonTuner(nil),1) implement one unrestricted Tuner plus one or more non-Tuners.

effects.clause: If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can return all Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls to the hand. If your opponent has 6 or more cards in their hand, they cannot activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation. You can only use this effect of Eclipse Observer Seara once per turn.
effects.lua: The delayed summon trigger checks SUMMON_TYPE_SYNCHRO, enumerates every opponent on-field Spell/Trap able to return, and sends the group to hand. At six or more opponent hand cards, Duel.SetChainLimit permits only the controller to respond. SetCountLimit(1,id) is the hard once-per-turn code.

effects.clause: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, then your opponent draws 2 cards. You can only use this effect of Eclipse Observer Seara once per turn.
effects.lua: EVENT_CHAINING requires an opponent Spell/Trap card activation and a negatable chain, verifies the mandatory two-card draw is legal, then negates, destroys, and only after successful destruction draws two. SetCountLimit(1,id+100) is distinct from the other effects.

effects.clause: If this card is sent to the GY: You can Set up to 2 Eclipse Quick-Play Spells from your GY or banishment. You can only use this effect of Eclipse Observer Seara once per turn.
effects.lua: EVENT_TO_GRAVE selects one or two settable Eclipse-named Quick-Play Spells from GY/face-up banishment, respects Necrovalley and available Spell/Trap Zones, and Sets them. The audit fixed the official-name pool to include both Book of Eclipse (35480699) and Book of Lunar Eclipse (31834488), in addition to the generated CCG Eclipse setcode. SetCountLimit(1,id+200) is distinct.
effects.notes: Confirmed pool defect: the prior Lua explicitly included Book of Eclipse but omitted the equally name-matching official Quick-Play Spell Book of Lunar Eclipse. Corrected by adding official ID 31834488 to the filter and listed names.

provenance.method: Fresh card-by-card, effect-by-effect review against official Omega database and scripts.
provenance.legacy_policy: Still-applicable manual unresolved classifications are preserved; all other conclusions are superseded by the fresh audit.

effects.clause: 2 Level 7 or higher LIGHT or DARK monsters
effects.lua: EnableReviveLimit plus AddFusionProcFunRep requires exactly two materials; s.fusfilter requires each material to be Level 7 or higher and to have LIGHT or DARK Attribute.

effects.clause: If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can target 1 Level 7 or lower LIGHT or DARK monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but negate its effects, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fusion Monsters. You can only use this effect of Ether Mademoiselle once per turn.
effects.lua: EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS checks SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION, targets a Level 7 or lower LIGHT/DARK monster through Necrovalley, Special Summons and disables it, then registers an Extra Deck Fusion-only summon restriction through the End Phase. SetCountLimit(1,id) supplies the hard once-per-turn limit.

effects.clause: During your turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use this effect of Ether Mademoiselle once per turn.
effects.lua: An EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect is restricted to the controller's turn, opponent activations whose activation location is on the field, and negatable chains; it negates activation and conditionally destroys the related handler. SetCountLimit(1,id+100) is a distinct hard once-per-turn code.
